# GitHub Pull Request #31

## Title
feat: load pi-durable extensions and answer their questions with GitHub checkboxes

## Description
Adds support for packages that ship a **pi-durable extension** (such as `pit/durable`), and a GitHub UI so their questions can be answered on the issue/PR.

## pi-durable extensions
- **Discovery**: a package whose `package.json` has `pi.durable` (a module path) is a pi-durable extension package. Its module exports `createPiDurableExtension(hostOptions)`, or a default export with the same signature, which returns a pi-durable `Extension`. When a package has both `pi.durable` and `pi.extensions`, only the durable entry is loaded, and the log says so.
- **Loading**: uses the same install path and jiti setup as pi extensions. `@earendil-works/pi-durable` and `@earendil-works/chord` (root and subpaths) are aliased to the action's copies, so extensions share the host's instances.
- **Installation**: the extensions go into the thread's registry after `CodingTools`, for every conversation. Duplicate names (including `coding-tools`) are rejected.
- **Host options**: `{ cwd, agentDir, trustProject, ui?, log }`.
  - `agentDir` is the new `agent_dir` input, or a temp dir under `RUNNER_TEMP`.
  - `trustProject` is the new `trust_project` input, default `false`; the README has a security note.
  - `ui` is passed only in comment mode on an issue/PR.

## GitHub UI (`src/github-ui.ts`)
- **`confirm` / `select`**: posts a comment with a hidden marker `<!-- pi-action:question <id> -->`, the message as a blockquote (so it can't pass for a checkbox), task-list items, and a line saying how long pi waits. It polls the comment every `poll_interval` until a box is ticked, the signal aborts, or `ui_timeout` passes (new input, default 300 s). The first ticked box wins. The comment is then edited to show `✅ Answered: …`, or that pi continued without an answer. If the marker or options were changed, the question is ignored and the comment restored.
- **`input`**: waits for a reply that starts with `/answer`. It must be posted after the question by someone allowed to run pi (`allowed_users`/`allowed_associations`/`allowed_bots`). Each reply answers one question, and pi reacts 👍 to it.
- **Not triggers**: question comments and `/answer` replies are never `@pi` triggers, either in thread polling (`triggers.ts`) or as the event that started the run (`run-context.ts`).
- **`notify`**: goes to the log and the job summary (`core.summary`, injected as `deps.summary`), not to comments.
- **GitHub client**: new `getComment` and `updateComment` methods.
- **Docs**: the trust model is documented in the README.

## Tests
- **Fixture**: `test/fixtures/extensions/durable-ask` has `pi.durable`, plus a `pi.extensions` entry that imports pi-coding-agent and must not load. Its `ask_user` tool calls `ui.confirm` and `ui.select` and reports the answers and host options.
- **End to end** (`run.test.ts`): the fixture is installed with `npm pack` and the real npm install into `RUNNER_TEMP`, outside the repo, so only the aliases can resolve pi-durable. A faux model drives the tool, and the mock GitHub client ticks a box on the second poll. Also covered: the `ui_timeout` path, the abort path (run timeout while waiting), and output mode (no UI).
- **Unit tests**:
  - checkbox parsing: `[x]`/`[X]`, unchecked, CRLF, quoted task lists, removed marker, changed or added options
  - `/answer` parsing and the allowlist
  - notify / summary
  - loading errors and aliases
  - host options and agent dir
- **Manual check**: also tried locally against `~/src/pit-durable` (branch `feat/durable`): `createPitDurableExtension` loads through this path and yields the `pit` extension with its `typescript` tool and catalog sections.

`npm run check` passes; no dependency changes.

## Important: Artifact and Script Requirements

**CRITICAL:** After the GitHub Action finishes running, all files modified or created are lost, and the GitHub Action runner is destroyed. Therefore:

1. **All generated code and artifacts MUST be committed** - Any files you create, modify, or generate must be committed and pushed to the repository before the action completes. Nothing will persist otherwise.

2. **Any throw-away scripts generated MUST be run immediately** - If you create temporary scripts (like `/tmp/create-issues.sh` or similar), you must execute them during the same session. They will be lost when the runner terminates.

3. **Commit and push all work** - Always end your work by committing and pushing changes to ensure they persist beyond the GitHub Action execution.

+import { existsSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+
+import type { Extension } from "@earendil-works/pi-durable";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+
+import {
+	createDurableExtensions,
+	type DurableExtensionsOptions,
+} from "./durable-extensions.ts";
+import type { DurableExtensionFactory } from "./extensions.ts";
+import { createLogger, tempDir } from "./test-helpers.ts";
+import type { DurableHostOptions, DurableUi } from "./types.ts";
+
+const TAKEN = /named "coding-tools", which is already taken/u;
+const FAILED = /Could not create pi-durable extension b\.ts: boom/u;
+
+function factory(
+	source: string,
+	create: (options: DurableHostOptions) => Promise<Extension>,
+): DurableExtensionFactory & { create: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> } {
+	return { source, create: vi.fn(create) };
+}
+
+function options(
+	overrides: Partial<DurableExtensionsOptions> = {},
+): DurableExtensionsOptions {
+	return {
+		cwd: tempDir(),
+		agentDir: undefined,
+		trustProject: false,
+		ui: undefined,
+		log: createLogger(),
+		env: { RUNNER_TEMP: tempDir() },
+		...overrides,
+	};
+}
+
+describe("createDurableExtensions", () => {
+	it("does nothing without pi-durable extensions", async () => {
+		const opts = options();
+		await expect(createDurableExtensions([], opts)).resolves.toStrictEqual([]);
+		expect(readdirSync(String(opts.env["RUNNER_TEMP"]))).toStrictEqual([]);
+	});
+
+	it("passes the host options, with a temp agent directory under RUNNER_TEMP", async () => {
+		const ui: DurableUi = {
+			confirm: vi.fn<DurableUi["confirm"]>(),
+			select: vi.fn<DurableUi["select"]>(),
+			input: vi.fn<DurableUi["input"]>(),
+			notify: vi.fn<DurableUi["notify"]>(),
+		};
+		const opts = options({ trustProject: true, ui });
+		const a = factory("a.ts", async () => ({
+			name: "a",
+			tools: [
+				{
+					name: "t",
+					description: "",
+					parameters: {},
+					execute: vi.fn(),
+				},
+			],
+		}));
+		const b = factory("b.ts", async () => ({ name: "b" }));
+
+		const extensions = await createDurableExtensions([a, b], opts);
+
+		expect(extensions.map((e) => e.name)).toStrictEqual(["a", "b"]);
+		const [[host]] = a.create.mock.calls as [[DurableHostOptions]];
+		expect(host).toMatchObject({ cwd: opts.cwd, trustProject: true, ui });
+		const prefix = join(String(opts.env["RUNNER_TEMP"]), "pi-action-agent-");
+		expect(host.agentDir.startsWith(prefix)).toBe(true);
+		expect(existsSync(host.agentDir)).toBe(true);
+		expect(b.create.mock.calls[0]?.[0]).toMatchObject({
+			agentDir: host.agentDir,
+		});
+		expect(opts.log.info).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
+			"pi-durable extension a (a.ts): t",
+		);
+		expect(opts.log.info).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
+			"pi-durable extension b (b.ts): no tools",
+		);
+	});
+
+	it("uses agent_dir relative to the workspace, and gives no ui when there is none", async () => {
+		const opts = options({ agentDir: ".pi-agent" });
+		const a = factory("a.ts", async () => ({ name: "a" }));
+		await createDurableExtensions([a], opts);
+		const host = a.create.mock.calls[0]?.[0] as DurableHostOptions;
+		expect(host.agentDir).toBe(join(opts.cwd, ".pi-agent"));
+		expect(existsSync(host.agentDir)).toBe(true);
+		expect("ui" in host).toBe(false);
+	});
+
+	it("rejects taken names and reports failing factories", async () => {
+		await expect(
+			createDurableExtensions(
+				[factory("a.ts", async () => ({ name: "coding-tools" }))],
+				options(),
+			),
+		).rejects.toThrow(TAKEN);
+		await expect(
+			createDurableExtensions(
+				[
+					factory("b.ts", async () => {
+						throw new Error("boom");
+					}),
+				],
+				options(),
+			),
+		).rejects.toThrow(FAILED);
+	});
+});

+import { mkdir, mkdtemp } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
+
+import type { Extension } from "@earendil-works/pi-durable";
+import { CodingTools } from "@earendil-works/pi-durable/tools";
+
+import type { DurableExtensionFactory } from "./extensions.ts";
+import type { DurableUi, Log } from "./types.ts";
+import { getErrorMessage } from "./utils.ts";
+
+export interface DurableExtensionsOptions {
+	/** The workspace (the checked-out repository). */
+	cwd: string;
+	/** The `agent_dir` input, relative to the workspace; a temp dir under RUNNER_TEMP when unset. */
+	agentDir: string | undefined;
+	/** The `trust_project` input. */
+	trustProject: boolean;
+	/** The GitHub UI, in comment mode on an issue or PR. */
+	ui: DurableUi | undefined;
+	log: Log;
+	env: Record<string, string | undefined>;
+}
+
+/** The `agent_dir` input, or a fresh directory under RUNNER_TEMP. */
+async function agentDirectory(
+	options: DurableExtensionsOptions,
+): Promise<string> {
+	if (options.agentDir) {
+		const dir = resolve(options.cwd, options.agentDir);
+		await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
+		return dir;
+	}
+	const base = options.env["RUNNER_TEMP"] || tmpdir();
+	await mkdir(base, { recursive: true });
+	return mkdtemp(join(base, "pi-action-agent-"));
+}
+
+/**
+ * Builds the pi-durable extensions the `extensions` input declared, with the run's host options, for the thread's
+ * registry. Their names must not collide with each other or with pi-action's coding tools.
+ */
+export async function createDurableExtensions(
+	factories: readonly DurableExtensionFactory[],
+	options: DurableExtensionsOptions,
+): Promise<Extension[]> {
+	if (factories.length === 0) {
+		return [];
+	}
+	const { cwd, trustProject, ui, log } = options;
+	const agentDir = await agentDirectory(options);
+	log.info(
+		`pi-durable extensions: agent directory ${agentDir}, project ${trustProject ? "trusted" : "not trusted"}, ${ui ? "questions answered on GitHub" : "no UI"}`,
+	);
+	const names = new Set([CodingTools.name]);
+	const extensions: Extension[] = [];
+	for (const factory of factories) {

+/**
+ * A pi-durable extension, as `pit/durable` ships one: `createPiDurableExtension(options)` returns an extension with
+ * an `ask_user` tool that asks `ui.confirm` and `ui.select` and reports the answers (and the host options), so
+ * tests can drive pi-action's GitHub UI end to end.
+ */
+import { defineTool, type Extension } from "@earendil-works/pi-durable";
+
+interface Ui {
+	confirm: (
+		title: string,
+		message: string,
+		options?: { signal?: AbortSignal },
+	) => Promise<boolean>;
+	select: (
+		title: string,
+		options: string[],
+		opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal },
+	) => Promise<string | undefined>;
+	notify: (message: string, level?: "info" | "warning" | "error") => void;
+}
+
+interface HostOptions {
+	cwd?: string;
+	agentDir?: string;
+	trustProject?: boolean;
+	ui?: Ui;
+	log?: { info: (msg: string) => void; warning: (msg: string) => void };
+}
+
+export function createPiDurableExtension(options: HostOptions = {}): Extension {
+	options.log?.info(
+		`durable-ask: trustProject=${String(options.trustProject)}`,
+	);
+	return {
+		name: "durable-ask",
+		tools: [
+			defineTool({
+				name: "ask_user",
+				description: "Ask the user to confirm a deployment and pick a color",
+				parameters: { type: "object", properties: {} },
+				async execute(_args, _api, context) {
+					const { ui } = options;
+					if (!ui) {
+						return { output: [{ type: "text", text: "no ui" }] };
+					}
+					const signal = context.abortSignal;
+					const dialog = signal ? { signal } : {};
+					const ok = await ui.confirm(
+						"Deploy?",
+						"Ship it to production?",
+						dialog,
+					);
+					const color = await ui.select("Color", ["red", "green"], dialog);
+					ui.notify(`deploy=${String(ok)}`);
+					return {
+						output: [
+							{
+								type: "text",
+								text: `confirm=${String(ok)} select=${color ?? "none"} agentDir=${options.agentDir ?? ""}`,
+							},
+						],
+					};
+				},
+			}),
+		],
+	};
+}
